reference.title: Widget API and message protocol
reference.shortdesc: The OpenDHelp object, the <opend-help-button> element, and the messages the panel and your page exchange.

section.title: The script
section.p: /embed/opend-help.js defines window.OpenDHelp and the opend-help-button custom element. It has no dependencies, can be loaded from any origin, and is cached for five minutes. Loading it twice is harmless.

section.title: OpenDHelp.init(options)
section.p: Call once before anything else; open throws until you do.

property.propdesc: Base URL of the docs site, such as https://docs.example.com. Messages are only accepted from, and sent to, its origin.
Your app's name, as in resourceid appname.
Returns a promise of a fresh embed token from your backend. Called whenever the panel has no session. If it rejects, the panel shows that sign-in failed.
Panel width in pixels. Screens narrower than 600 pixels get a full-width panel.
Called with { topicId, title } whenever the panel shows a topic, for analytics or to remember the last topic.

section.title: Methods
section.p: A context is { key: 'tenants.detail' } or { path: '/tenants/acme' }.

strow.stentry: Opens the panel, on the given context or the last one set. Remembers which element had focus.
Closes the panel and returns focus, even into shadow DOM.
Closes the panel if it is open, otherwise opens it.
Records where the user is. Reloads the panel if it is open.
Whether the panel is open.

section.p: Escape closes the panel, whether focus is in your page or in the panel.

section.title: <opend-help-button>

strow.stentry: Open this context key instead of the current context.
Open the context for this path.
Accessible name of the button. Default "Help for this page".

section.p: The button is a round "?" that inherits your text colour. Style it from outside with opend-help-button::part(button).

section.title: postMessage protocol
section.p: The panel is an iframe on the docs origin. It and the widget talk with window.postMessage. Every message is an object with protocol: 'opend-help' and v: 1 plus a type. Both sides check event.origin and event.source, and always send to an explicit origin, never *.

strow.stentry: panel to page
The panel has no session. The widget calls getToken.
page to panel
{ token }: the embed token. The panel posts it to /embed/session and reloads.
panel to page
The panel has a session and has loaded.
panel to page
{ topicId, title }: the panel shows a topic. Passed to onNavigate.
panel to page
The reader closed the panel from inside it.
panel to page
{ message }: the token exchange failed.

section.p: The panel only talks to the page when the page's origin is in the allowed origins: the widget passes its own origin to the panel's URL as host, and the server checks it. Opened anywhere else, the panel runs standalone and sends no messages.
